title: feat(core): an action's param dialog description, helpText and outcomeMessages fill {{ }} template holes, and still fill ${…}
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoBCpS3vE7HS7cD6zZzsAPjZ)_

Part of #27948

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：控制台的动作文案里，参数对话框的 `description`、每个参数的 `helpText`、以及 `outcomeMessages` 现在也会填 `{{ record.x }}` / `{{ result.x }}` 这种模板洞（含 `{{ amount | currency:USD }}` 格式化），和 `confirmText` / `successMessage` 用同一个模板引擎；原来的 `${…}` 写法照旧能填。
- 为什么改：规范要求带参数的动作把确认问句从 `confirmText` 挪到 `description`，可挪过去后 `{{ record.x }}` 原样显示成花括号；裁决 A（「同意」）定五个文案键统一成 `{{ }}`，渲染端先行。这是第 1 步。
- 风险与回滚：只改 `@object-ui/core` 的动作运行器；一句话里有 `{{ }}` 就只走模板引擎（同句里的 `${…}` 当普通文字），没有就走旧的 `${…}`，现有文案行为不变；回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：ui/packages/core/src/actions/ActionRunner.ts（`dialogCopyFiller`、`composeSuccessMessage` 第一档）、ui/packages/core/src/actions/actionCopyTemplate.ts（`fillTransitionalCopy`）、ui/packages/core/src/actions/__tests__/ActionRunner.transitionalCopy-27948.test.ts。
- 两分钟验证：`cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/core/src/actions/__tests__/ActionRunner.transitionalCopy-27948.test.ts`，预期 15/15 通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Step 1 of #27948, ruling 6545229148, letter A (renderer first). The five action copy keys become one ADR-0032 `{{ }}` template slot. `confirmText` and `successMessage` already read it; the param dialog's `description`, each param's `helpText`, and `outcomeMessages` read only `${…}`. So an author following the spec (move the confirm question of an action with params from `confirmText` to `description`) saw `{{ record.x }}` printed raw, from the record header and from a row.

- `ui/packages/core/src/actions/actionCopyTemplate.ts`: `fillTransitionalCopy(text, fillTemplate, fillLegacy)`, one dialect per sentence, the rule `confirmText` / `successMessage` kept through their own transition (objectui#13367 until objectui#13476): a sentence with a `{{ }}` hole is filled by the template engine alone, so a `${…}` token in it stays text and a filled value is never read a second time; a sentence with none keeps its `${…}` reading.
- `ui/packages/core/src/actions/ActionRunner.ts`:
  - The `interpolate` handed to the param-collection handler is now `dialogCopyFiller(action)`: `{{ }}` holes fill over `record` (the row on a row dispatch, the page's record on the header) and the action's static `params`, exactly the roots `confirmText` reads (factored out of `confirmMessage` as `recordCopyRoots`); `${…}` still goes through `templateEvaluatorFor` (objectui#12967). Both handlers (`useConsoleActionRuntime`, `RecordDetailView`) already pass that `interpolate` to the dialog for `description` and `helpText`, so no app-shell code moves.
  - `composeSuccessMessage` rung 1 (`outcomeMessages`): `{{ }}` holes fill over `result` and `record`, the roots `successMessage` reads, with the viewer's locale and tenant currency; `${result.*}` still goes through `substituteScopeTokens`.
  - Doc comments on `ActionDef.outcomeMessages`, `ParamCollectionHandler`, `RUNNER_TEXT`, `templateEvaluatorFor` and `substituteScopeTokens` say which spelling each reads.
- `.changeset/27948-action-copy-template-holes.md`: `@object-ui/core` patch.

No `packages/spec/**` change: the describe text, the publish refusal of `${…}` and the migration of existing `${…}` copy are step 2, after this is on `main`.

## Tests

`ui/packages/core/src/actions/__tests__/ActionRunner.transitionalCopy-27948.test.ts`, 15 pins through the real runner and `@objectstack/formula`'s `templateEngine`, reading what the host is handed (the dialog's `interpolate` output and the toast handler's argument):

- `description` + `helpText`, on the header door and the row door (`params._rowRecord`, as `ObjectGrid` dispatches): the card's case (the `confirmText` sentence `Pause {{ record.display_name }}?` reads the same moved to `description`), a `${record.x}` hole still fills, an unknown `{{ x }}` hole reads exactly as `confirmText` reads it; a formatter hole; a mixed sentence (`{{ }}` wins, `${…}` stays text); a filled value is not re-read as `${…}`.
- `outcomeMessages`: `{{ result.x }}`, `{{ record.x }}` from the row, a formatter hole, `${result.x}` still fills, an unknown `{{ x }}` reads as `successMessage` reads it, a mixed sentence.

Reverse check against the unfixed runner (`ActionRunner.ts` and `actionCopyTemplate.ts` restored from `5da3a8ce`, test file kept): 12 failed, 3 passed. The 3 that stay green are the `${…}` keepers, which pin preservation and are meant to pass on both. Restore proven by an empty `git diff HEAD`.

## Acceptance notes

- **Order inside one sentence.** One dialect per sentence, as the ruling's "decide and pin the order" asks: a `{{ }}` hole makes the whole sentence a template; `${…}` in it is text. This is the reading `confirmText` / `successMessage` had during their transition, so step 2's refusal of `${…}` changes nothing for a sentence that already has a `{{ }}` hole.
- **Roots.** The dialog copy reads `record` and static `params` (not the collected values, which do not exist yet, the same as `confirmText`); `outcomeMessages` reads `result` and `record`. The `${…}` path keeps its wider scope (the whole runner context) until step 2 retires it; step 2's migration should check producers for `${user.*}`-style holes, which have no `{{ }}` root here.
- **Envelope.** These three keys are still read as strings: `description` / `helpText` are localized in app-shell before `interpolate`, and `outcomeMessages` entries are read only when they are strings. If step 2 types them as template slots that parse to the `{ dialect, source }` envelope, the readers must accept the envelope first (the trap objectui#13367 closed for `confirmText` / `successMessage`), or a served entry silently falls back.
- Registered producers using `${result.*}` in `outcomeMessages` / `successMessage` (platform-objects' invitation copy) are untouched; `${…}` keeps filling.
